roleplays.title: Catching Up With a Friend
roleplays.description: Casual conversation asking how your friend is doing, weekend plans, and catching up over coffee.
roleplays.initial_message_en: Hey! Long time no see! How have you been?
roleplays.initial_message_hi: अरे! बहुत दिनों बाद मिले! तुम कैसे हो सब कैसा चल रहा है?
roleplays.initial_message_te: హే! చాలా రోజులైంది చూసి! ఎలా ఉన్నావు?
suggested_replies_en: I'm doing great! Just busy with work. How about you?
Everything is good! Are you free this weekend?
Hey! Yes, really long time. Let's catch up soon!
roleplays.learning_focus: Casual greeting, using 'how have you been', friendly tones.

roleplays.title: At a Grocery or Tech Shop
roleplays.description: Asking about product availability, prices, discounts, and payment methods.
roleplays.initial_message_en: Hello! Welcome to our store. Are you looking for anything specific today?
roleplays.initial_message_hi: नमस्ते! हमारी दुकान में आपका स्वागत है। क्या आप आज कुछ खास ढूँढ रहे हैं?
roleplays.initial_message_te: నమస్కారం! మా దుకాణానికి స్వాగతం. మీరు ఏదైనా ప్రత్యేకంగా చూస్తున్నారా?
suggested_replies_en: Yes, do you have this item in stock?
How much does this cost? Is there any discount?
Do you accept UPI or card payment?
roleplays.learning_focus: Polite shopping inquiries, asking prices, payment methods.

roleplays.title: Work Meeting & Project Update
roleplays.description: Discussing project progress, deadlines, file sharing, and next steps with a colleague or manager.
roleplays.initial_message_en: Good morning! Can you give a quick update on where we stand with the presentation?
roleplays.initial_message_hi: सुप्रभात! क्या आप प्रेजेंटेशन की वर्तमान स्थिति के बारे में संक्षेप में बता सकते हैं?
roleplays.initial_message_te: శుభోదయం! ప్రజంటేషన్ ఏ దశలో ఉందో సంక్షిప్తంగా చెప్పగలరా?
suggested_replies_en: Good morning! I have completed the initial draft and sent the file to your email.
Almost done, just finalizing the metrics slides. I'll share it by 2 PM.
Could we do a quick 5-minute review call before sending it to the client?
roleplays.learning_focus: Professional tone, work deadlines, scheduling follow-ups.

roleplays.title: Asking for Directions
roleplays.description: Asking a passerby for directions to the metro station or landmark.
roleplays.initial_message_en: Excuse me! Could you tell me where the nearest metro station is?
roleplays.initial_message_hi: एक्सक्यूज़ मी! क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि पास का मेट्रो स्टेशन कहाँ है?
roleplays.initial_message_te: నమస్కారం! దగ్గరలోని మెట్రో స్టేషన్ ఎక్కడ ఉందో చెప్పగలరా?
suggested_replies_en: Go straight for 200 meters and take the first right turn.
Is it within walking distance or should I take an auto?
Thank you so much for your help!
roleplays.learning_focus: Spatial prepositions, polite requests with 'Excuse me'.

roleplays.title: Job Interview Practice
roleplays.description: Answering common interview questions like self-introduction, strengths, and experience.
roleplays.initial_message_en: Welcome to the interview! To start off, could you briefly introduce yourself and your background?
roleplays.initial_message_hi: साक्षात्कार में आपका स्वागत है! शुरुआत के लिए, क्या आप अपना और अपनी पृष्ठभूमि का संक्षेप में परिचय दे सकते हैं?
roleplays.initial_message_te: ఇంటర్వ్యూకి స్వాగతం! ప్రారంభించడానికి, మీ గురించి మరియు మీ నేపథ్యం గురించి సంక్షిప్తంగా పరిచయం చేయగలరా?
suggested_replies_en: Thank you. I have over three years of experience building responsive web and mobile applications.
I specialize in frontend technologies and cross-cultural communication tools.
I graduated in computer science and enjoy creating accessible software.
roleplays.learning_focus: Formal professional self-introduction, active verbs, concise articulation.
